meta.title: Open Frame Studio — OpenAEC Foundation
meta.description: Open Frame Studio: free, open-source software for designing, documenting and exporting window and door frames — 2D editor, 3D view, frame schedule, workshop drawing and IFC export.

header.label: Window frame design
header.title: Open Frame Studio
header.tagline: Free frame software, from drawing to frame schedule
header.desc: Design windows, doors and glazed screens, including arched and round ones, in 2D and 3D. From the same model, produce cutting lists, hardware and glass lists, a cutting plan, workshop drawings and IFC, and check energy, circularity and strength. For timber, aluminium, uPVC and timber-aluminium.

features.label: Features
features.heading: From first sketch to workshop and checks
features.sub: Start with the highlights or pick a topic.

editor.alt: An arched timber frame with two tilt-and-turn windows in the 2D editor, with dimensions
editor.title: Draw any frame, arched and round too
editor.desc: Start from a template or an empty frame and divide it into panes. Rectangular, arched and round frames get the same pane layout, and glass rebates, glazing beads and sashes follow the arch. The dimension chain always adds up.

view3d.alt: A section through an aluminium tilt-and-turn window in the 3D viewer
view3d.title: See in 3D how it fits together
view3d.desc: The 3D viewer follows the drawing one to one, with a view cube and standard views. Cut through the frame and see how sash, stop and gaskets meet, or pull timber parts apart to inspect tenons, shoulders and blind mortises.

materials.alt: A double tilt-and-turn window in anthracite aluminium in the 2D editor
materials.title: Timber, aluminium and uPVC to system dimensions
materials.desc: uPVC and aluminium frames take the sash sizes, stop and sealing levels of the chosen profile system, also for round and arched frames. Timber has KVT profiles in various wood species.

production.alt: The production lists with the cutting list of a timber tilt-and-turn window
production.title: All production lists from the model
production.desc: A cutting list with arc lengths, radii and saw angles, plus glass, hardware, gasket, panel and glazing bead lists and a parts list. The hardware follows the opening direction and the fitting space of each sash. Everything also as PDF, Excel and CSV.

cutting.alt: Cutting optimisation with the layout per stock length
cutting.title: Less waste with cutting optimisation
cutting.desc: Spread all pieces over stock lengths of a chosen size. For each bar you see the layout, the number of bars, the yield percentage and the total waste, and different profile articles go on separate bars.

analysis.alt: Circularity and material passport with mass, recyclability and CO₂ per material
analysis.title: Energy, circularity and strength at a glance
analysis.desc: Calculate the Uw value, create a material passport with mass, recyclability and CO₂, and run an indicative check on wind load and deflection. A standards pre-check for CE and SKH/KOMO shows what is still missing.

editor.title: Free 2D editor
editor.desc: Grid subdivision, drag handles, dimension lines and infills, with hinge side, opening direction, glazing bead and hardware per pane.

arched.title: Arched and round
arched.desc: Arched and round frames, with rebates, glazing beads and opening sashes following the arch.

templates.title: Templates
templates.desc: Tilt-and-turn window, double tilt-and-turn, sliding door, front door, door with side light and your own templates to build on.

view3d.title: 3D with section
view3d.desc: A 3D viewer with view cube, standard views, section and the connection of sash, stop and gaskets.

joints.title: Inspect mortise and tenon
joints.desc: Pull the timber parts apart and see the tenons, shoulders and blind mortises of each joint.

conventions.title: Dutch drawing conventions
conventions.desc: Dimensioning to NEN 3576 and opening symbols to VKG and EN 12519 in the outside view.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.desc: Type “Make a tilt-and-turn 900×1400” and the frame is there. Works with an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, including a local one.

profiles.title: Profile editor
profiles.desc: Edit a profile cross-section point by point, with mirroring, snap grid and undo.

timber.title: Timber
timber.desc: KVT profiles (54, 67, 78 and 90 mm) in meranti, accoya, spruce, oak, FSC hardwood and softwood.

alu.title: Aluminium
alu.desc: Aluminium profiles with the dimensions and sealing levels of the chosen system, and 45° mitres.

pvc.title: uPVC
pvc.desc: uPVC profiles with the sash sizes, stop and seals of the chosen system.

timberAlu.title: Timber-aluminium
timberAlu.desc: Combination profiles with timber inside and aluminium outside.

batten.title: Cavity batten per side
batten.desc: Switch a cavity batten on or off for each side of the frame; the drawing and the front view follow its thickness.

cutting.title: Cutting list and joints
cutting.desc: A cutting list with arc lengths, radii and saw angles, and joints made by the book.

hardware.title: Hardware
hardware.desc: The hardware follows the opening type, the hinge side and the fitting space of each sash.

glass.title: Glass and gasket lists
glass.desc: A glass list with the glass size of each pane and a gasket list with part references per sash.

optimise.title: Cutting optimisation
optimise.desc: Pieces spread over stock lengths, with yield percentage and total waste.

schedule.title: Frame schedule
schedule.desc: Frame schedule as PDF and Excel, with sizes, material, glazing and Ug value per frame.

workshop.title: Workshop drawing
workshop.desc: A3 workshop drawings with a title block, clear pane sizes and the centre positions of mullions and transoms, and DXF with dimension lines.

planning.title: Production planning, purchasing and quotes
planning.desc: A production schedule in hours and working days, purchase proposals and quotes from the same project.

ifc.title: IFC export
ifc.desc: Frames as IFC4, also per component, plus glTF for 3D. The exchange is still in development.

blender.title: Blender and Bonsai
blender.desc: Send frames straight to Blender with Bonsai for further IFC modelling.

energy.title: Energy
energy.desc: Uw value per frame and for the project, with glass area and transmission loss.

circularity.title: Circularity
circularity.desc: A material passport with mass, recyclability and CO₂ per material.

plausibility.title: Plausibility
plausibility.desc: An indicative check of wind load and deflection per jamb and sill.

certification.title: Standards pre-check
certification.desc: An indicative pre-check for CE and SKH/KOMO. Not a certification.

ids.title: IDS and BCF
ids.desc: Check the project against IDS requirements and track issues in BCF.

dashboard.title: Project dashboard
dashboard.desc: Frames, panes, facade area and the breakdown by material and window type in one overview.

download.label: Download

download.mobileNote: On a phone or tablet, open Open Frame Studio in the browser. For the full package, download the app on your computer.

whatsnew.label: New in v2026.47 and v2026.48
whatsnew.title: From drawing frames to making frames
whatsnew.desc: Eight releases came out in the past two weeks. Open Frame Studio now goes beyond drawing: from production lists and cutting plan to energy and circularity. The full list is in the release notes.

workspaces.title: Twenty workspaces
workspaces.desc: From 2D and 3D to cutting plan, energy, circularity and certification, in one window with a ribbon that adapts to the width.

arched.title: Arched and round, down to the cutting list
arched.desc: Glass, glazing beads and sashes follow the arch, and the cutting list gives radii, arc lengths and saw angles.

joints.title: Mortise and tenon per joint
joints.desc: Choose the tenon side and tenon length for each joint and view the joint pulled apart in 3D.

systems.title: Profile systems
systems.desc: uPVC and aluminium follow the dimensions and seals of the chosen system, with a separate stop profile.

hardware.title: Hardware that thinks along
hardware.desc: Hardware follows the opening type and fitting space, with part references in the hardware and gasket lists.

workshop.title: Better workshop drawing
workshop.desc: Clear pane sizes, centre positions of mullions and transoms, and a cavity batten per side in the drawing.

price.q: What does Open Frame Studio cost?
price.a: Nothing. Open Frame Studio is free and open source, under the CC BY-SA 4.0 licence. No subscription and no licence fees per user.

install.q: Do I need to install anything?
install.a: Not to try it: open the web version in your browser. It cannot yet do everything the desktop app can. For the full package, install the app for Windows, macOS or Linux.

materials.a: Timber, aluminium, uPVC and timber-aluminium. Timber parts are tenoned, aluminium and uPVC parts are mitred, and you see that in the drawing, the 3D view and the cutting list.

bim.q: Can I use my frames in a BIM model?
bim.a: Yes. You export frames as an IFC file, or send them straight to Blender with Bonsai. The IFC exchange is still in development: check the result in your own BIM software before you build on it.

production.q: Can I use it for production right away?
production.a: Not without checking yet. Open Frame Studio is in development and not a validated package for manufacturer costing, compliance statements or machine control. The checks on energy, strength and standards are indicative. Always check sizes, lists and machining yourself before you start production.

languages.q: Which languages does the app support?
languages.a: Dutch, English, German and Turkish. The drawing conventions follow Dutch practice, such as dimensioning to NEN 3576.

update.q: How do I get a new version?
update.a: The app has no automatic updater yet. Download the new installer on this page and run it.

tech.heading: Technology
tech.sub: For those who want to know how it is built.

tauri.title: Tauri 2
tauri.desc: A thin native shell for Windows, macOS and Linux, with a small installer.

svelte.title: Svelte 5
svelte.desc: The interface, with an SVG editor for the 2D drawing.

three.title: Three.js
three.desc: The 3D view of frame, glass and masonry.

wasm.title: WebAssembly
wasm.desc: The same Rust core runs in the browser version.

ifc.title: IFC4
ifc.desc: Open exchange with BIM software, and a link with Blender and Bonsai.
